recognize_zh: 骨髓中胚細胞與單核樣細胞（核折疊、細胞質灰藍）增生，箭頭所指的細胞含有粗大、深紫黑色的異常嗜伊紅性顆粒（abnormal eosinophil），這種單核球分化加上異常嗜伊紅球的組合是 inv(16) 急性骨髓性白血病的典型線索。
features: Increased blasts and monocytoid cells with moderate gray-blue cytoplasm
Folded, indented or reniform nuclei with fine chromatin (myelomonocytic differentiation)
Abnormal eosinophil precursor with large, dark purple-black (basophilic-staining) granules (arrow)
Few mature neutrophils; a small nucleated red cell present
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased blasts and monocytoid cells with folded or reniform nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm, some with vacuoles. An abnormal eosinophil precursor with coarse, dark purple-black granules is present (arrow). Mature granulocytes are reduced. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia with abnormal eosinophils, suggestive of AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22) or t(16;16); CBFB-MYH11, which should be confirmed by cytogenetics/FISH or RT-PCR.

ddx.vs: AMML lacks the dysplastic eosinophils with large basophilic-staining granules and lacks CBFB-MYH11 on molecular testing.
CMML has <20% blasts plus promonocytes and persistent monocytosis, while inv(16) AML is diagnostic regardless of blast count.

ddx.dx: Myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 rearrangement
ddx.vs: These show increased but cytologically less dysplastic eosinophils without the coarse basophilic granules, and are identified by FISH/RT-PCR for the specific rearrangement.
